D/ IMP C P LIC VALERIANVS P F AVG ; R/ RESTITVTOR ORBIS

Complete, Roman copper alloy radiate of Valerian I (253-260). Mint: Rome, second series, AD 256-7. RIC 117; Cunetio 495. Reece Period 12. Obverse inscription: IMP C P LIC VALERIANVS P F AVG. Obverse description: Radiate draped cuirassed bust right. Reverse inscription: RESTITVTOR ORBIS. Reverse description: Emperor standing left holding spear and raising kneeling female
